About this event

Capital Latina offers its Salsa and Bachata program in Tel Aviv every Thursday night. These weekly events feature open-level dance classes followed by a party in two halls.

The evening starts at 20:45 with gates opening, and at 21:00, instructors lead Salsa classes for all levels—no prior experience or partner needed. At 22:20, social dancing begins, blending Salsa and Bachata rhythms.

Hosted at Country Dekel, located at 69 Rabbi Kozovsky Street in Tel Aviv, this event draws a diverse crowd.

Admission is 50 NIS for locals and 30 NIS for out-of-towners. Discount cards are available: 180 NIS regular and 160 NIS for students or soldiers (4 entries per card).
